description: List your Robinhood Chain copy-trade rules. Each rule mirrors 1+ TRACKED KOL wallets (the set behind /rhc/kol/wallets) and emits a signal (webhook and/or the rhc:copytrade:signals WS channel) when they trade on chain 4663. Returns id, name, source_wallets, min_trade_eth, only_action, sizing_mode, sizing_amount, delivery_mode, webhook_url, is_active. Rule caps are PER CHAIN and do not consume the Solana copy-trade budget: PRO 3 rules / 5 wallets each, ULTRA 20 / 50, BUSINESS 100 / 250. Tier: PRO+.
name: rhc_copytrade_list
